verdict.rationale: Every skill ships as a plain `SKILL.md` file in its own folder (review/, qa/, ship/, cso/ and others), and dev mode just symlinks the repo into `.claude/skills/` [gstack-docs-16]. The docs list a dozen supported hosts and say adding one means creating one config file [gstack-docs-12][gstack-docs-46], and a compressed AGENTS.md digest covers hosts without a full install [gstack-docs-47]. Community reports of a git-clone-and-copy install and of repackaging gstack for gitagent show the files are readable and copyable [gstack-comm-2][gstack-comm-4]. missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that skills are hand-portable markdown without needing gstack's host generator, and clarity on how far skills depend on the compiled `$B` browser binary when carried to another harness.
